content.title: IPL 2026 Points Table After MI Vs PBKS: Latest Standings And Net Run Rate After Punjab Beat Mumbai | MI Vs PBKS
content.text: Punjab Kings pulverised Mumbai Indians in IPL 2026 on Thursday (April 16). Here is what the IPL 2026 points table looks like after that result. IPL 2026: Updated points table after PBKS vs MI After restricting Mumbai Indians to 195-6, Punjab Kings chased down the total with seven wickets and 21 balls in hand to jump to the top of the points table. Still unbeaten after five games, their only loss of a point has been due to a washed-out game against the Kolkata Knight Riders. Mumbai, meanwhile, stayed at ninth place after four defeats on the trot. Team P W L NR Pts NRR Punjab Kings 5 4 0 1 9 +1.067 Royal Challengers Bengaluru 5 4 1 0 8 +1.503 Rajasthan Royals 5 4 1 0 8 +0.889 Sunrisers Hyderabad 5 2 3 0 4 +0.576 Delhi Capitals 4 2 2 0 4 +0.322 Gujarat Titans 4 2 2 0 4 -0.029 Lucknow Super Giants 5 2 3 0 4 -0.804 Chennai Super Kings 5 2 3 0 4 -0.846 Mumbai Indians 5 1 4 0 2 -1.076 Kolkata Knight Riders 5 0 4 1 1 -1.383 What were the talking points in MI vs PBKS, IPL 2026 Match 24? MI reached 195-6 in 20 overs after Shreyas Iyer won the toss and opted to field at the Wankhede Stadium. Coming in for the injured Rohit Sharma, Quinton de Kock (112* in 60 balls) became the first designated wicketkeeper to score three IPL hundreds. Naman Dhir biffed his way to a 31-ball 50 as well, even as Arshdeep Singh finished with 4-0-22-3. Coming out all guns blazing, PBKS became 45-2 before Prabhsimran Singh (80* in 39) and Iyer (66 in 35) added 139 in a mere 66 balls to remove any doubt over the outcome. Who were the top performers in MI vs PBKS? While making an excellent hundred, de Kock’s hundred was perhaps too slow on a flat deck where dew posed a problem in the second half. Arshdeep, on the other hand, was phenomenal on a pitch where every bowler struggled to keep Prabhsimran or Iyer in check.
